Properties.Description: Silences prod alarms, scales ECS to 0, stops RDS denali-prod

Code.ZipFile:
import boto3
import json
import time

ecs = boto3.client('ecs', region_name='us-east-1')
rds = boto3.client('rds', region_name='us-east-1')
cloudwatch = boto3.client('cloudwatch', region_name='us-east-1')

CLUSTER = 'denali'
SERVICE = 'denali-web'
DB_INSTANCE = 'denali-prod'
PROD_ALARMS = [
    'denali-prod-healthy-hosts-below-1',
    'denali-prod-alb-5xx-rate-high',
]


def lambda_handler(event, context):
    results = []

    # Silence alarms BEFORE scaling down so the scale-to-0
    # doesn't trigger ALARM -> SNS -> email during scheduled
    # shutdown window.
    try:
        cloudwatch.disable_alarm_actions(AlarmNames=PROD_ALARMS)
        results.append(f'Alarms: actions disabled ({len(PROD_ALARMS)})')
    except Exception as e:
        results.append(f'Alarm disable error: {str(e)}')

    try:
        ecs.update_service(cluster=CLUSTER, service=SERVICE, desiredCount=0)
        results.append('ECS: scaled to 0')
    except Exception as e:
        results.append(f'ECS error: {str(e)}')

    time.sleep(5)

    try:
        db = rds.describe_db_instances(DBInstanceIdentifier=DB_INSTANCE)
        status = db['DBInstances'][0]['DBInstanceStatus']
        if status == 'available':
            rds.stop_db_instance(DBInstanceIdentifier=DB_INSTANCE)
            results.append('RDS: stop initiated')
        elif status == 'stopped':
            results.append('RDS: already stopped')
        else:
            results.append(f'RDS: skipped (status={status})')
    except Exception as e:
        results.append(f'RDS error: {str(e)}')

    print(json.dumps(results))
    return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': results}

Properties.Description: Starts RDS denali-prod, polls until available, scales ECS to 1, re-enables prod alarms

Code.ZipFile:
import boto3
import json
import time

ecs = boto3.client('ecs', region_name='us-east-1')
rds = boto3.client('rds', region_name='us-east-1')
cloudwatch = boto3.client('cloudwatch', region_name='us-east-1')

CLUSTER = 'denali'
SERVICE = 'denali-web'
DB_INSTANCE = 'denali-prod'
MAX_WAIT = 600
ECS_READY_WAIT = 180
PROD_ALARMS = [
    'denali-prod-healthy-hosts-below-1',
    'denali-prod-alb-5xx-rate-high',
]


def lambda_handler(event, context):
    results = []

    # Start RDS first (longest-latency operation)
    try:
        db = rds.describe_db_instances(DBInstanceIdentifier=DB_INSTANCE)
        status = db['DBInstances'][0]['DBInstanceStatus']
        if status == 'stopped':
            rds.start_db_instance(DBInstanceIdentifier=DB_INSTANCE)
            results.append('RDS: start initiated')
        elif status == 'available':
            results.append('RDS: already available')
        else:
            results.append(f'RDS: status={status}, waiting...')
    except Exception as e:
        results.append(f'RDS start error: {str(e)}')
        return {'statusCode': 500, 'body': results}

    # Wait for RDS available
    elapsed = 0
    while elapsed < MAX_WAIT:
        try:
            db = rds.describe_db_instances(DBInstanceIdentifier=DB_INSTANCE)
            status = db['DBInstances'][0]['DBInstanceStatus']
            if status == 'available':
                results.append(f'RDS: available after {elapsed}s')
                break
        except Exception:
            pass
        time.sleep(15)
        elapsed += 15
    else:
        results.append(f'RDS: timeout after {MAX_WAIT}s')

    # Scale ECS back to 1
    try:
        ecs.update_service(cluster=CLUSTER, service=SERVICE, desiredCount=1)
        results.append('ECS: scaled to 1')
    except Exception as e:
        results.append(f'ECS error: {str(e)}')

    # Poll for ECS task to reach RUNNING before re-enabling
    # alarm actions. Prevents a transient ALARM -> email
    # during the ~1-2 min task launch window.
    ecs_elapsed = 0
    ecs_ready = False
    while ecs_elapsed < ECS_READY_WAIT:
        try:
            svc = ecs.describe_services(cluster=CLUSTER, services=[SERVICE])
            running = svc['services'][0]['runningCount']
            if running >= 1:
                results.append(f'ECS: running={running} after {ecs_elapsed}s')
                ecs_ready = True
                break
        except Exception:
            pass
        time.sleep(10)
        ecs_elapsed += 10

    if not ecs_ready:
        results.append(f'ECS: running>=1 not reached within {ECS_READY_WAIT}s')

    # Re-enable alarm actions. Do this regardless of whether
    # running=1 was confirmed -- if we don't reach this line,
    # alarms stay silent which is a bigger problem.
    try:
        cloudwatch.enable_alarm_actions(AlarmNames=PROD_ALARMS)
        results.append(f'Alarms: actions enabled ({len(PROD_ALARMS)})')
    except Exception as e:
        results.append(f'Alarm enable error: {str(e)}')

    print(json.dumps(results))
    return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': results}

Properties.Description: Re-stops RDS if auto-restarted while ECS is scaled to 0

Properties.Name: denali-shutdown-nightly
Properties.Description: Every night 10:00pm CT (03:00 UTC, CDT pin - drifts to 9pm CST in winter). Runs ALL days incl. weekends; no-op if already stopped.

Properties.Name: denali-startup-daily
Properties.Description: Weekdays only 8:55am CT (13:55 UTC, CDT pin - drifts to 7:55am CST in winter). 5-min head start for ~7min RDS+ECS boot; site available ~9:02am CT. Weekends OFF - manual start: aws lambda invoke --invocation-type Event --function-name denali-startup /tmp/out.json

Properties.Name: denali-safety-stop-cron
Properties.Description: Every 6 days re-stop RDS if ECS is 0 (handles 7-day auto-restart)
